{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Remove rows where customer_age is -1 (invalid age)
valid_sales_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute the mean age of valid customers
mean_age_valid = valid_sales_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Compute the number of valid records
n_valid = len(valid_sales_df)

# Print the results
print(f'Mean age: {mean_age_valid}')
print(f'Number of valid records: {n_valid}')"}
